questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to improve my spanish language. I have visited Barcelona many times, and so far it is my favourite place and therefore I found it very appealing to go. I also heard good things about my university, so that was another motivation.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:

questions.answer: It was easy. We had an introduction day so that helped.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: We had an introduction meeting, where we could ask questions.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: There could have been a guided tour around the university.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.answer: It takes a train ride of 50 minutes to go to university from center Barcelona.
